rows.ja: 供給元(GPU・データセンター・ストレージ)

relations.text: CoreWeaveのインフラで使うGPUはすべてNVIDIA製
relations.text_en: All GPUs used in CoreWeave’s infrastructure are NVIDIA GPUs, as required by customer contracts

source.label: CoreWeave 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: all of the GPUs used in our infrastructure today are NVIDIA GPUs

relations.text: NVIDIAが協業拡大とあわせ、CoreWeaveのクラスA普通株に1株87.20ドルで20億ドルを出資
relations.text_en: NVIDIA invested $2B in CoreWeave Class A common stock at $87.20 per share alongside an expanded collaboration

source.label: CoreWeave/NVIDIA joint の発表
source.quote: NVIDIA has invested $2 billion in CoreWeave Class A common stock at a purchase price of $87.20 per share

relations.text: NVIDIAが、Vera Rubinプラットフォームの立ち上がりで、CoreWeaveなどの提携先でラックが稼働していると報告
relations.text_en: NVIDIA reported the Vera Rubin platform ramping with racks running at partners including CoreWeave

source.label: NVIDIA 8-K(2027年度第2四半期決算発表)
source.quote: racks running at partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius

relations.text: CoreWeaveが年次報告で、NVIDIAは半導体の製造をTSMCに頼っていると説明
relations.text_en: CoreWeave states NVIDIA relies on TSMC for semiconductor fabrication, an upstream dependency of CoreWeave’s GPU supply

source.label: CoreWeave 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: NVIDIA relies on suppliers such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company for semiconductor fabrication
source.note: 間接的な関係です。TSMCが直接供給するのはNVIDIAです。
source.note_en: Indirect: TSMC supplies NVIDIA, not CoreWeave directly.

relations.text: CoreWeaveのクラスターは、GPUとあわせてAMD(とIntel)のCPUを使う
relations.text_en: CoreWeave clusters use AMD (and Intel) CPUs alongside GPUs

source.label: CoreWeave 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: CoreWeave clusters also use cutting edge CPUs, including AMD and Intel chips
source.note: 一般的な製品利用の記載で、契約や数量は書かれていません。
source.note_en: A generic product-use statement; no named contract or volume.

relations.text: CoreWeaveのクラスターは、GPUとあわせてIntel(とAMD)のCPUを使う
relations.text_en: CoreWeave clusters use Intel (and AMD) CPUs alongside GPUs

source.label: CoreWeave 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: CoreWeave clusters also use cutting edge CPUs, including AMD and Intel chips
source.note: 一般的な製品利用の記載で、契約や数量は書かれていません。
source.note_en: A generic product-use statement; no named contract or volume.

relations.text: CoreWeaveはCore Scientificのコロケーション事業の唯一の顧客で、CoreWeaveのインフラを約590MW分ホスティング
relations.text_en: CoreWeave is the sole customer of Core Scientific’s Colocation segment, which hosts CoreWeave’s infrastructure (about 590 MW leased)

source.label: Core Scientific 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: One customer, CoreWeave, currently accounts for 100% of our Colocation segment revenue.

relations.text: Core Scientificは、株主が2025年10月30日に否決したためCoreWeaveとの全株式交換型の合併契約を解除
relations.text_en: Core Scientific terminated the all-stock merger agreement with CoreWeave after its stockholders rejected it on October 30, 2025

source.label: CoreWeave 8-K
source.quote: Core Scientific terminated the Merger Agreement, effective immediately
source.note: 買収は解除され、成立していません。
source.note_en: The proposed acquisition was terminated and is no longer pending.

relations.text: Applied DigitalがPolaris Forge 1のデータセンター容量をCoreWeaveに貸し出し、契約分は合計400MW
relations.text_en: Applied Digital leases data center capacity at Polaris Forge 1 to CoreWeave, totalling 400 MW contracted

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K
source.quote: bringing the total contracted capacity at Polaris Forge 1 under our CoreWeave leases to 400 MW

relations.text: Polaris Forgeのデータセンター賃貸に関連して、Applied DigitalがCoreWeaveにワラントを発行
relations.text_en: Applied Digital issued warrants to CoreWeave in connection with the Polaris Forge data center leases

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K
source.quote: the Company issued to CoreWeave a warrant
source.note: CoreWeaveはその後、ワラントの一部を第三者に譲渡しています。
source.note_en: CoreWeave later assigned portions of the warrants to third parties.

companies.name: Galaxy Digital
companies.sub: 暗号資産・データセンター

relations.text: GalaxyがHelios キャンパスのデータセンター容量をCoreWeaveに貸し出している
relations.text_en: Galaxy leases data center capacity at its Helios campus to CoreWeave

source.label: Galaxy Digital 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have entered into lease agreements with CoreWeave for data center capacity at our Helios campus.

relations.text: BackblazeがCoreWeaveのマネージドストレージ向けに、数エクサバイトの容量(約3.35億ドル・5年間)を供給することで合意
relations.text_en: Backblaze agreed to supply multi-exabyte storage capacity (about $335M, five years) for CoreWeave’s managed storage

source.label: Backblaze 8-K Exhibit 99.1 の発表
source.quote: Under the multi-exabyte, $335 million agreement, Backblaze will provide cost-efficient storage capacity that supports portions of CoreWeave

relations.text: CoreWeaveが、企業向けSSDの優先確保でSolidigmと複数年契約を締結
relations.text_en: CoreWeave signed a multi-year agreement with Solidigm for priority access to enterprise SSD capacity

source.label: CoreWeave の発表
source.quote: a multi-year strategic agreement with Solidigm , a pioneer in enterprise data storage
source.note: 相手はSK hynix傘下のSolidigmで、発表にはSK hynixの名前は出ていません。
source.note_en: The counterparty is Solidigm, a subsidiary of SK hynix; the release does not name the parent.

relations.text: Sprout Socialが、2026年第2四半期に取引を伸ばせた顧客の1社としてCoreWeaveを挙げている
relations.text_en: Sprout Social lists CoreWeave among customers it grew with in Q2 2026

source.label: Sprout Social 2026年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: During the second quarter, we had the opportunity to grow with new and existing customers, including Salesforce, Cintas, MillerKnoll, Church & Dwight, Regal Cinemas, Wiley, and CoreWeave.
source.note: CoreWeaveがSprout Socialのソフトを購入する側です。
source.note_en: CoreWeave buys Sprout Social’s software.

relations.text: Microsoftは2025年の売上の約67%を占めるCoreWeave最大の顧客
relations.text_en: Microsoft was CoreWeave’s top customer, accounting for about 67% of 2025 revenue

source.label: CoreWeave 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We recognized an aggregate of approximately 67% of our revenue from our top customer, Microsoft, for the year ended December 31, 2025.

relations.text: CoreWeaveが決算書類で、汎用クラウドの主な競合の1社としてMicrosoft(Azure)を挙げている
relations.text_en: CoreWeave names Microsoft (Azure) as a key competitor in general-purpose cloud computing (and notes some are also customers)

source.label: CoreWeave 10-Q(2026年第2四半期)
source.quote: Key competitors that offer general purpose cloud computing services as part of a broader, diversified product portfolio include Amazon (AWS), Google (Google Cloud Platform), Microsoft (Azure), and Oracle, a number of which are also our current customers.
source.note: 一部の企業は顧客でもある、と同じ書類に記載があります。
source.note_en: The filing notes that some of these companies are also customers.

relations.text: Metaが新たな発注書で、2032年までのクラウド容量に約210億ドルを支払うことを当初コミット
relations.text_en: Meta initially committed to pay CoreWeave about $21B under a new order form for cloud capacity through 2032

source.label: CoreWeave 8-K
source.quote: Meta has initially committed to pay the Company approximately $21 billion

relations.text: OpenAIが、基本サービス契約に基づく発注書で、2031年5月までに最大約65億ドルを支払うことをコミット
relations.text_en: OpenAI committed to pay CoreWeave up to about $6.5B through May 2031 under an order form to a master services agreement

source.label: CoreWeave 10-Q(2026年第2四半期)
source.quote: OpenAI committed to pay us up to approximately $6.5 billion through May 31, 2031
source.note: OpenAIは未上場です。
source.note_en: OpenAI is not listed.

relations.text: CoreWeaveとOpenAI OpCoが2025年3月7日付のStock Issuance Agreement(株式発行契約)の当事者として、重要な添付書類に記載
relations.text_en: CoreWeave and OpenAI OpCo are party to a Stock Issuance Agreement dated March 7, 2025, listed as a material exhibit

source.label: CoreWeave 10-K(2025年度) exhibit index
source.quote: Stock Issuance Agreement between CoreWeave, Inc. and OpenAI OpCo, LLC, dated March 7, 2025
source.note: 添付書類の一覧での言及で、契約内容はこの引用には書かれていません。
source.note_en: An exhibit-index reference only; the agreement terms are not described in the quote.

relations.text: Anthropicが、CoreWeaveのクラウド基盤でClaudeのワークロードを動かす複数年契約を発表
relations.text_en: CoreWeave announced a multi-year agreement under which Anthropic will run Claude workloads on CoreWeave’s cloud platform

source.label: CoreWeave の発表
source.quote: Under the agreement, Anthropic will use CoreWeave
source.note: Anthropicは未上場です。
source.note_en: Anthropic is not listed.

relations.text: Flow Tradersが、AI・ディープラーニング部門の主なAIクラウド基盤としてCoreWeaveを選んだ
relations.text_en: Flow Traders selected CoreWeave as primary AI cloud platform provider for its AI and deep learning division

source.label: CoreWeave の発表
source.quote: Flow Traders, a leading global liquidity provider, selected CoreWeave as the primary AI cloud platform provider for its AI and deep learning division

relations.text: Nissanが、AIで実車テストを減らすMonolith(現在はCoreWeaveの一部)との戦略的提携を延長
relations.text_en: Nissan extended its strategic partnership with Monolith (now part of CoreWeave) using AI to reduce physical vehicle tests

source.label: CoreWeave ニュースルーム
source.quote: Nissan and Monolith (now a part of CoreWeave) have announced a three-year extension to their strategic partnership
source.note: 関係はCoreWeaveが2025年11月に買収したMonolithとのものです。
source.note_en: The relationship is with Monolith, acquired by CoreWeave in November 2025.

relations.text: CrowdStrikeが、安全なAIクラウド基盤に向けたCoreWeaveとの世界的な提携を発表
relations.text_en: CrowdStrike unveiled a global partnership with CoreWeave for a secure AI cloud foundation

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Exhibit 99.1
source.quote: Unveiled a global partnership with CoreWeave to power the secure AI cloud foundation for the agentic era

relations.text: LeidosとCoreWeaveが、米国の国家安全保障向けの安全なソブリンAIクラウドサービスを共同で提供する
relations.text_en: Leidos and CoreWeave are teaming up to provide secure, sovereign AI cloud services for U.S. national security missions

source.label: CoreWeave/Leidos の発表
source.quote: Leidos (NYSE: LDOS), a leader in national security mission solutions, and CoreWeave (Nasdaq: CRWV), The Essential Cloud for AI TM , are teaming up to provide secure, sovereign AI cloud services
source.note: 協業は予定の段階として書かれています。
source.note_en: The collaboration is described as intended or planned.

relations.text: 三菱UFJ銀行が、CoreWeaveの85億ドルのつなぎ型タームローン(DDTL 4.0)の管理代理人・幹事
relations.text_en: MUFG Bank is administrative agent and lead arranger of CoreWeave’s $8.5B DDTL 4.0 delayed draw term loan facility

source.label: CoreWeave 8-K
source.quote: with MUFG Bank, Ltd., as administrative agent, U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association as collateral agent
source.note: CoreWeave子会社への融資で、融資関係のみです。
source.note_en: A lender to a CoreWeave subsidiary borrower; a financing relationship only.

relations.text: Morgan Stanley Senior Fundingが、CoreWeaveの31億ドルのDDTL 5.0の管理代理人
relations.text_en: Morgan Stanley Senior Funding is administrative agent of CoreWeave’s $3.1B DDTL 5.0 facility

source.label: CoreWeave 8-K
source.quote: with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc., as administrative agent
source.note: CoreWeave子会社への融資で、融資関係のみです。
source.note_en: A lender to a CoreWeave subsidiary borrower; a financing relationship only.

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bankが、CoreWeaveの26億ドルのDDTL 5.5の管理代理人
relations.text_en: JPMorgan Chase Bank is administrative agent of CoreWeave’s $2.6B DDTL 5.5 facility

source.label: CoreWeave 8-K
source.quote: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent
source.note: CoreWeave子会社への融資で、融資関係のみです。
source.note_en: A lender to a CoreWeave subsidiary borrower; a financing relationship only.

relations.text: Goldman Sachs Bank USAが、2025年7月28日付のCoreWeaveのつなぎ型タームローンの共同主幹事
relations.text_en: Goldman Sachs Bank USA is joint lead arranger on a CoreWeave delayed draw term loan facility dated July 28, 2025

source.label: CoreWeave 10-K(2025年度) exhibit index
source.quote: MUFG Bank, Ltd. and Goldman Sachs Bank USA, as joint lead arrangers
source.note: 添付書類の一覧にある2025年7月のDDTL 3.0への言及です。
source.note_en: An exhibit-index reference to the July 2025 DDTL 3.0 credit agreement.

companies.name: みずほフィナンシャルグループ

relations.text: Mizuho Markets Americasが、CoreWeaveの2026年4月のキャップド・コール取引の相手方
relations.text_en: Mizuho Markets Americas is a counterparty to CoreWeave’s April 2026 capped call transactions

source.label: CoreWeave 8-K
source.quote: Mizuho Markets Americas LLC (with Mizuho Securities USA LLC acting as agent)
source.note: 転換社債のヘッジ取引で、相手は子会社のMizuho Markets Americas LLCです。
source.note_en: A convertible-note hedge; the counterparty is the subsidiary Mizuho Markets Americas LLC.

source.quote: potentially positioning us to emerge as a competitor to AI cloud providers such as Coreweave and Nebius
source.note: 将来の競合の可能性で、目論見書によるとNasdaqに上場しています。
